period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's Q3-2025 unaudited financial statements; plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections used (Solo+OBU basis). Comparative column (31 Dec 2024) reproduces the known FY2024 Q4 equity of 3208.10m exactly. Equity deteriorated further into negative territory: -11352.77m (Sep 2025), down from -6720.15m (Jun 2025) -- continuing to worsen after the Q2-2025 crossing, on its way to the FY2025 year-end figure of -24002.90m already in this dataset. NAV per share printed correctly as negative this quarter: -3.53. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (9-month figures). RESTATEMENT NOTED (see also 2024_Q3.json): this filing's own Jan-Sep-2024 comparative column shows Net Profit after taxation of -13,605,707,399, which differs from the -17,873,515,228 reported contemporaneously in National Bank's own Q3-2024 filing -- the same restatement already flagged in 2024_Q3.json, now visible from the other side (i.e. it persists into this later comparative too, confirming it is a genuine restatement pattern applied to the 2024 comparatives shown in 2025 filings, not a one-off typo). This dataset's 2024_Q3.json keeps the contemporaneous (-17873.52m) figure per the standing rule; this record's own 2025 figures are unaffected by the restatement (it only concerns the -2024- comparative shown here). Tax again includes a large deferred-tax credit (current tax +318.08m, deferred tax -8481.40m, net -8163.32m). Source PDF was image-only; text obtained via OCR (tesseract, 300dpi). ROE for this quarter is null in ratios_timeseries.json per the negative-equity-breaks-ROE rule (equity has been negative since Q2-2025).
